blurb: Picturesque, intimate, extraordinary, and unforgettable. Lairmont Manor is a historic manor and estate venue in Bellingham, Washington, just up the hill from charming Fairhaven village. The manor was built in 1914 and has been a beloved event venue for the past 55 years.
